protocol.primary_comparison: Three routing methods with one frozen target-count allocation at each cap.
protocol.allocation_comparison: Within each routing method, reference versus DP allocation of that method's own outcomes.
protocol.nearest_baseline_note: Existing nearest-feasible method does not prioritize target tiers.
protocol.allocation_capacity_note: Identical upper bounds; actual route-days need not be equal.
protocol.runtime_note: Single local wall-clock measurements; selected zone solves and all outcome preparation are separate. No statistical runtime claim.
protocol.distance_note: Distance is descriptive. Compare tier coverage lexicographically before travel plus wait and maximum route duration.
protocol.scope_note: Coverage counts unique administrative targets, not residents. Operational assumptions are inherited from input.
